page_title: ALM 0-0 BET | Almeria v Betis 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by Almeria is thwarted by the well prepared Rui Silva (Betis).

89' Lazaro (Almeria) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a low shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the middle of the goal, but it lacks power and Rui Silva pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
86' Here is a change. Alejandro Pozo is going off and Gaizka Garitano gives the last tactical orders to Chumi (Almeria).
86' Lazaro (Almeria) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
83' Rui Silva (Betis) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
83' It is time for a substitution. Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) is on for German Pezzella.
81' Lazaro (Almeria) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
77' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Ruiz signals a set piece.
75' The corner from Isco (Betis) is cleared away by the defence.
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Largie Ramazani walks off the pitch to be replaced by Rachad Fettal (Almeria).
74' Gaizka Garitano has decided to make a change. Lazaro (Almeria) replaces Adrian Embarba.
74' Luiz Henrique (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Assane Diao.
74' Assane Diao (Betis) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

73' Luis Maximiano pulls off a great save to deny Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the top left corner. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
70' Almeria fail to score from a corner as Rui Silva (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
69' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.

66' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Rui Silva pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
64' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Isco (Betis), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
64' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Betis have a corner.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dion Lopy (Almeria) comes onto the pitch so that Gonzalo Melero can be given a rest.
62' CHANCE! Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
62' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
61' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Almeria will have an opportunity.
58' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Leo Baptistao (Almeria) a chance inside the box, but his efforts zips just over the bar.
58' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is about to take a corner kick.

58' A lofted cross from Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.
56' A loose ball is pounced on by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Luis Maximiano is alert and makes a comfortable save.
56' Isco (Betis) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

55' Abner (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
55' Chance! Sergio Arribas (Almeria) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Rui Silva is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
53' The free kick from close range, taken by Almeria, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Marc Roca (Betis) for his blatant foul.
49' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
48' The attendance for today's match is 14253.

46' A neat pass is well received by Adrian Embarba (Almeria), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
46' One of the Almeria players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
46' Here's the change. Ayoze Perez leaves the pitch and Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
46' Referee Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.

45+1' Isco (Betis) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Leo Baptistao (Almeria) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

44' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Leo Baptistao (Almeria) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Rui Silva pulls off a comfortable save.
42' What a huge chance for Sergio Arribas (Almeria). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
42' Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Rui Silva (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' It looks like Ayoze Perez (Betis) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Ruiz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
37' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Lucas Robertone (Almeria) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
34' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
32' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
30' Here is the reaction to a red card. Manuel Pellegrini makes a tactical substitution, Willian Jose leaves the pitch and Aitor Ruibal (Betis) comes on.
27' Hector Bellerin (Betis) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
26' Chance! Assane Diao (Betis) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
25' The Betis players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
21' Isco (Betis) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
18' Marc Roca (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' CHANCE! Willian Jose (Betis) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
13' Flag up against Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
12' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation.
11' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Ayoze Perez (Betis) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
7' Willian Jose (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
2' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Ruiz signals a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz will officiate today.
